The '''Mission to Dayark''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] mission to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dayark]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kathol Republic]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The crew of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' stood accused of crimes against the Kathol Republic and the destruction of one of its military vessels.
